Your questions, clearly answered.

Can I donate now?+

No. This version does not accept payments. You can prepare a partnership proposal. Payments require approval of the beneficiary and arrangements.

Are these amounts quotations?+

No. They are quantity and price assumptions with planning contingencies. The final budget and funding gap will follow quotations and a review of secured resources.

How are children protected?+

No individual child profiles or identifiable family information are published. Child portraits are held pending image-permission approval.

Does a contribution qualify for tax relief?+

No tax benefit or tax receipt is promised. These depend on the legal framework and recipient entity, which are still to be confirmed.
